_doc: LEARNED STYLE MODEL - numeric constants measured from motion-capture takes of a bass player. Derived parameters only: no raw capture, no audio and no personal data is included or required. The generator consumes any MIDI plus this file.

left_hand_grip_envelope_deg._doc: playing grip is ~half the static channel grip; per joint mean/sd from 361 aligned frames

position_shift_dynamics._doc: measured big shifts: quick + early, NOT spread over the gap
position_shift_dynamics.small_shift_behavior: gradual drift across the whole gap

note_attraction._doc: wrist follows style trajectory, softly pulled to the required spot near notes (proven: 45.6mm -> 12.3mm median press residual)

fingering_laws.priority_1: correct note on the designed finger; realism second, as inspiration within limits
fingering_laws.slap_string: always the deepest string; pops on the high strings
fingering_laws.riff_climb: pivot-cycle: cycle advances on fret change; repeated fret restrikes same finger; repeat after pinky pivots to index (pattern-2 entry)
fingering_laws.economy_default: flair is authored, economy is default: outside designed showpieces use nearest reachable finger, index may stretch one fret back

right_hand_slap._doc: left-relative wrist rotation (room/dance subtracted); take-3 249s segment
right_hand_slap.doctrine: see quest_hands/SLAP_BASS_DOCTRINE.md: slap:pop 7:1, thumb 2.72 m/s, contact +9ms, badink 100ms stagger

bass_groove_motion._doc: left-wrist height over ABSOLUTE floor drives the instrument: grip point follows, bass body hangs by constant-length strap
bass_groove_motion.strap_law: fixed length per character (male 1.562m); stretch>100% = constraint violation, resolve by rotating the bass around the strap anchors

alignment_protocol._doc: recording protocol: count-in stamps are ground truth; pattern matching is ambiguous on repetitive songs

right_hand_walking._doc: measured from the 2026-08-08 VR walking take, in the PALM's own frame so head angle and floor tilt cancel out
right_hand_walking.rule: hand anchored on the planted thumb; ring+pinky clawed and still; index and middle alternate, each pressing through its string and retracting
